summary: Sidebar/kanban/conversation-list previews used to show the first raw, mid-sentence words of the latest assistant reply. The agent now reports a one-line status wrapped in <agent_digest>...</agent_digest> (a prompt rule appended for Claude and Codex, which have a clean instructions seam; OpenCode's ACP does not, so it keeps today's raw preview). src/shared/agent-digest.ts is pure and provider-agnostic: extractDigest pulls the last complete tag for previews (capped ~120 chars); stripDigest(text, { streaming }) removes complete tag pairs always, and additionally hides a still-forming trailing tag only when streaming is true - a FINISHED message that merely quotes the literal tag with no close (this file's own OPEN_TAG constant, for instance) is left alone, which fixed a CodeRabbit-caught bug where that case silently ate the rest of the message in the chat bubble, on copy, on mobile, and on Android. src/shared/turn-preview.ts (also CodeRabbit-prompted) makes the preview search every assistant message in the CURRENT TURN (everything after the last user message) for a digest before falling back to raw text, since Claude splits a turn into several messages at tool calls and the newest one often has no digest of its own yet. The raw message is stored unchanged everywhere - all of this runs at render time only, so previews are derived live from in-memory session/thread state (agent-store on desktop, the chat store on mobile) and reset on reload rather than needing a DB migration.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android gains the conversation-list digest preview once BrowseThreadActivityIndex accumulates live assistant text per thread (it currently tracks only status/unread/pending-attention, not content) the way the desktop agent-store and the mobile chat store already do; until then the conversation list shows today's status/time only, with no raw tag and no preview line. The required, unflagged part - stripping <agent_digest> out of the rendered transcript so a raw tag never shows on the phone - already ships unconditionally, no flag needed.

storageDataMigration.reason: The raw message/content text is stored unchanged everywhere (ChatMessage.content on desktop, FeedItem.text on mobile and Android) - extractDigest/stripDigest run at render time only, deriving the preview from in-memory session state. No column, table, or wire-format field was added, and no migration is touched.

notExercised: No live Claude or Codex turn was run against a real account with the appended prompt rule; the systemPrompt/developerInstructions wiring was verified by unit test and by reading the installed codex-cli's generated JSON schema (ThreadStartParams/ThreadResumeParams), not by observing a real agent emit a tag.
The claim that OpenCode's ACP has no instructions seam was checked by reading @agentclientprotocol/sdk's NewSessionRequest/PromptRequest types, not by probing a live opencode acp session.
The Android conversation-list digest preview is staged and unbuilt, so it has nothing to exercise yet.
Android's chat-text stripping (ThreadScreen.kt TextRow) was verified only via AgentDigestTest.kt's JVM unit tests, not on a physical device or emulator.

The desktop sidebar Recents preview and kanban card preview were not visually verified in a running build - only through renderToStaticMarkup-based unit tests and the pure previewLine/sessionPreviewLine/turnPreviewLine helpers.
No live multi-message Claude turn (a real tool-call split) was observed end to end; the turn-boundary and cross-message digest search is verified only against synthetic message arrays.
